ITEM.PTXT: The synchronous injection duration can be expressed by the following formula.

When the engine is started, the injection duration is determined by the engine speed, battery voltage and coolant temperature. Also, to prevent excessive injection during starting, the injection volume is increased or decreased according to the cranking time.

INDICATE.TITLE: Synchronous injection = A. Basic injection duration + B. Correction injection duration + C. Invalid injection duration

ENTRY.PTXT: A. Basic Injection Duration
The basic injection duration determined by the intake air volume and engine speed.
B. Correction Injection Duration
Coefficients for producing an air-fuel mixture with an appropriate air-fuel ratio according to the engine conditions at that time, based on signals from each sensor.
B-1 Intake Air Temperature Correction
When the intake air temperature is low, the air density is high, so the volume is increased.
B-2 Warm-up Enrichment Correction
When the coolant temperature is low, the volume is increased to ensure driveability when cold.
B-3 After-start Enrichment Correction

After the engine starts, the volume is increased according to coolant temperature and engine speed to stabilize the engine speed after starting. The enrichment ratio is greatest immediately after starting and then gradually decreases.
B-4 Transient Air-fuel Ratio Correction
Acceleration or deceleration is judged from changes in intake air volume, and the volume is increased or decreased according to the condition.
B-5 Wall Wetting Correction
Fuel adhesion to the walls is calculated from the coolant temperature, engine speed and throttle opening angle and corrected.
B-6 High Load Enrichment Correction
High-load operation is judged from signals from each sensor, and the volume is increased to prevent exhaust temperature rise.
B-7 Air-fuel Ratio Feedback Control

O2Correction is performed based on signals from the sensor, and the air-fuel ratio is controlled within a narrow range near the stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, where the purification performance of the three-way catalyst is high.
B-8 Constant Fuel Pressure Control
Deviations in fuel injection volume caused by changes in intake manifold pressure are corrected by constant fuel pressure control.
C. Invalid Injection Duration
Corrects for the operation delay of the injectors.
